why: Variant 3 has the strongest emotional arc — the vulnerability confession (the ticket, the hair, 'I used to be good at leaving') earns the quotable instead of just setting it up, the possessive edge stays soft-yandere rather than drifting into banter-boyfriend like V2, and it's the only one that lands the quotable clean AND then actually descends into a sleep close without re-spiking.
fixes: Cut 'Little paws.' in the open — it's too cutesy for the possessive undertone and cheapens the tension the cold open needs.

In the 'I know your maps' section, cut 'it'd be the third day of the month, and I'd know why' — the unexplained specificity pulls the listener out to solve a puzzle right before the quotable needs total emotional focus.
